title: Efficient K-generalizable Learned Search
abstract: arXiv:2603.06159v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learned top-K search improves the accuracy-latency trade-off of graph-based vector search, but existing methods are designed for a fixed K: serving production workloads with varying K values requires preprocessing cost proportional to the number of distinct Ks served - prohibitive in practice. This paper shows that learned search can support arbitrary K with the preprocessing cost of a single top-1 model. The key idea is to reduce top-K learned search to repeated masked top-1 refinement, which works because the distance-reduction trajectory for discovering the next top-1 vector is largely invariant to the number of results already found. We therefore train the model on trajectory features that remain effective under masking. translated_title: 高效的K值可泛化学习搜索
translated_abstract: 学习型top-K搜索提升了基于图的向量搜索在准确率与延迟之间的权衡，但现有方法是为固定的K值设计的：在服务具有不同K值的生产工作负载时，其预处理成本与所服务的不同K值数量成正比——这在实践中是难以承受的。本文表明，学习型搜索能够以单个top-1模型的预处理成本支持任意K值。其关键思想是将top-K学习搜索简化为重复的带掩码top-1精化，这之所以可行，是因为发现下一个top-1向量所需的距离缩减轨迹在很大程度上与已找到的结果数量无关。因此，我们在掩码下仍然有效的轨迹特征上训练模型。为了使重复精化过程既鲁棒又高效，OMEGA通过按排名的置信度分配来对抗跨迭代的误差累积，并通过统计预测跳过不必要的模型调用。
tldr: 该论文提出OMEGA方法，将top-K学习搜索转化为重复的带掩码top-1精化过程，使基于图的向量搜索仅需单个top-1模型的预处理成本即可支持任意K值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OMEGA, which reduces top-K learned search to repeated masked top-1 refinement, enabling graph-based vector search to support arbitrary K values with the preprocessing cost of only a single top-1 model.
